name: Connie
source:
Connie recently turned eighteen and she has just graduated from high school. For the past five years she has been attending an all-girls religious school, and she would only return home to see family and friends at Christmas and during summer break.

She does not want to be seen as a "spoilt rich kid" and she has no interest in having any part of the family business.

Her father is the Seascape Hotel owner and she is the younger sister of [url=/c100656]Brodie[/url].

Connie recently turned eighteen and she has just graduated from high school. For the past five years she has been attending an all-girls religious school, and she would only return home to see family and friends at Christmas and during summer break.

She does not want to be seen as a "spoilt rich kid" and she has no interest in having any part of the family business.

Her father is the Seascape Hotel owner and she is the younger sister of [url=/c100656]Brodie[/url].
